title: Full function across supply range 9.0 V to 16.0 V
procedure: Set chamber/HIL ambient to 23 °C and supply to 12.0 V. Confirm controller is awake and WLC_Status is received. Set supply to 9.0 V (lower boundary). Perform one manual close, one manual open, one express open (press shorter than 300 ms) and read WLC_Status after each. Set supply to 16.0 V (upper boundary). Repeat step 2. Set supply to 12.0 V. Repeat step 2. Note: 9.0 V also falls in the WLC-002 range; record any reduced-function behaviour at 9.0 V as a finding.
pass_criteria: Manual open/close, express open and WLC_Status operate at 9.0 V, 12.0 V and 16.0 V: [TBD: limit needed]

title: Reduced function between 6.0 V and 9.0 V: manual only, express disabled
procedure: Set ambient to 23 °C, window at 240 mm, supply 9.0 V (upper boundary of range). Hold the switch in close direction for 2 s and record motion. Release. Make a short press (about 100 ms) in close direction and record whether express motion starts. Set supply to 8.9 V and repeat steps 2 and 3. Then set supply to 6.1 V (lower boundary) and repeat. Set supply to 5.9 V and confirm the controller is outside this range (TC-003 covers this case).
pass_criteria: Window moves while switch is held between 6.1 V and 9.0 V: [TBD: limit needed]; Express motion started by a short press between 6.1 V and 9.0 V: [TBD: limit needed]

title: Motor stop within 50 ms when supply falls below 6.0 V
procedure: Set ambient to 23 °C and supply to 13.5 V. Start manual close at mid-travel so the motor is running and steady. Ramp the supply down at a rate fast enough to cross 6.0 V within 10 ms. Log the time at which supply first reads below 6.0 V and the time at which motor current reaches 0 A. Set supply to 5.9 V (just below the 6.0 V limit) and repeat the test with the motor running in express close. Restore 13.5 V and confirm normal operation.
pass_criteria: Time from supply below 6.0 V to motor stop (manual and express): within 50 ms

title: Sleep-mode supply current below 100 µA at 12 V
procedure: Connect the controller to a 12.0 V supply through a series ammeter with resolution of 1 µA or better. Set ignition off, all doors closed, no switch input. Wait until the controller enters sleep mode (confirm on bus or by current signature). Record the mean supply current over 60 s. Repeat once after a switch press and return to sleep, to check the sleep state is reached again.
pass_criteria: Supply current in sleep mode at 12 V: less than 100 µA

title: Reverse battery polarity -14 V for 60 s without damage
procedure: At 12.0 V, record a functional baseline: one manual open, one manual close, and a WLC_Status message. Connect the supply in reverse polarity at -14 V with a current-limited supply. Hold for 60 s. Disconnect, restore 13.5 V and repeat the functional baseline. Inspect the controller for visible damage and check the baseline results match.
pass_criteria: Controller damage after -14 V reverse polarity for 60 s: without damage

title: Manual mode: motion while switch held, stop within 100 ms of release
procedure: Set ambient to 23 °C and supply to 13.5 V. Place window at 240 mm. Hold the switch in close direction for 2 s and confirm motion. Release and measure time from switch release to motor stop. Repeat the hold-and-release sequence 10 times at positions 10 mm, 240 mm and 470 mm, and in both directions. Record the maximum stop time across all runs.
pass_criteria: Time from switch release to motor stop (maximum of 10+ runs): within 100 ms of switch release; Window motion while switch is held: [TBD: limit needed]

title: Movement allowed after ignition off for 60 s or until front door opened
procedure: Set supply to 13.5 V, window at 240 mm, ignition on. Switch ignition off and start the timer. At 59 s after ignition off, press and hold the switch in close direction for 2 s. Record whether the window moves. Wait for the controller to return to sleep. Repeat: switch ignition on, then off, and at 61 s after ignition off attempt a switch movement. Record whether the window moves. Repeat with a front door opened at 30 s after ignition off and a switch press at 35 s. Record whether the window moves. Restore ignition on.
pass_criteria: Window movement after ignition off, with no door opened: 60 s or until a front door is opened, whichever comes first; Window movement after a front door is opened before 60 s: 60 s or until a front door is opened, whichever comes first

title: Short press (<300 ms) starts express mode in pressed direction
procedure: Set ambient to 23 °C and supply to 13.5 V. Place window at 240 mm, ignition on. Make a switch press of 299 ms in the close direction (just inside the limit). Release and record whether the window continues to the fully closed position without the switch held. Make a switch press of 301 ms in the close direction (just outside the limit). Record whether express motion starts. Repeat step 2 in the open direction with the window at 240 mm.
pass_criteria: Express motion after a 299 ms press in each direction: shorter than 300 ms; Express motion after a 301 ms press (behaviour at 300 ms and above is not specified): [TBD: limit needed]

title: Express mode stopped by a second switch press in either direction within 100 ms
procedure: Set supply to 13.5 V, ambient 23 °C, window at 240 mm. Start express close with a 299 ms press. Once the window is moving, make a second short press in the close direction (100 ms). Measure time from second press to motor stop. Start express open with a 299 ms press from fully closed. During movement, make a second short press in the close direction. Measure time to motor stop. Repeat steps 2 and 3 with the second press in the opposite direction.
pass_criteria: Time from second switch press to motor stop, for both directions: within 100 ms

title: Full travel time from fully open to fully closed: 3.0 s to 4.5 s at 13.5 V and 23 °C
procedure: Set supply to 13.5 V and stabilise the chamber/HIL at 23 °C. Start from fully open (480 mm), with no obstruction in the window path. Start express close with a 299 ms press. Measure time from motor start to motor stop at fully closed (0 mm) using the controller-reported position. Repeat three times. Record the travel time of each run.
pass_criteria: Travel time from 480 mm to 0 mm at 13.5 V and 23 °C (each of three runs): 3.0 s to 4.5 s

title: Motor stopped when window reaches end position
procedure: Set supply to 13.5 V, ambient 23 °C, ignition on. Express close from fully open with no obstruction. Record motor current and reported position until motor stops. Express open from fully closed. Record motor current and position until motor stops. For each run, note the reported position at motor stop and the time from end position reached to motor current reaching 0 A.
pass_criteria: Motor current after reaching end position (0 mm and 480 mm): [TBD: limit needed]; Time from end position reached to motor stop: [TBD: limit needed]

title: WLC_CloseAll closes window in express mode with anti-pinch active
procedure: Precondition: controller is normalized (see TC-022). Set supply to 13.5 V, window at 300 mm, ignition on, no switch input. From the HIL body controller, send WLC_CloseAll. Record motion, movement state in WLC_Status and whether the window moves without switch input. Repeat with a simulated obstacle at 100 mm applying 81 N during closing. Record whether anti-pinch detects the obstacle and reverses.
pass_criteria: Window closes to fully closed after WLC_CloseAll, with no switch input held: [TBD: limit needed]; Anti-pinch detection and reversal during WLC_CloseAll with 81 N obstacle: [TBD: limit needed]

title: Express close only available when controller is normalized
procedure: Set supply to 13.5 V, window at 240 mm. Interrupt supply for 600 ms to make the controller not normalized. Confirm normalization state in WLC_Status. Make a short press (100 ms) in close direction. Record whether express motion starts. Normalize the controller by following TC-022 (manual hold at fully closed for 1 s). Confirm normalization state. Move the window to 240 mm and repeat the short press in close direction. Record whether express motion starts.
pass_criteria: Express close start while not normalized: [TBD: limit needed]; Express close start while normalized: [TBD: limit needed]

title: Pinch detection threshold: force exceeds 80 N in pinch zone 4 mm to 200 mm
procedure: Use a calibrated pinch force rig with a force-controlled obstacle. Set controller to normalized, supply 13.5 V, ambient 23 °C. Place the rig so that the closing window meets it at the lower pinch zone boundary (4 mm). Apply a constant force of 79 N (just inside, not exceeding the threshold) during closing. Record whether detection occurs. Repeat step 2 with a constant force of 81 N (just outside, above the threshold). Record whether detection occurs. Repeat steps 2 and 3 with the rig at the upper pinch zone boundary (200 mm).
pass_criteria: Pinch detection at applied force, pinch zone 4 mm to 200 mm: exceeds 80 N

title: Pinch response: stop within 10 ms and reverse at least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less
procedure: Set controller to normalized, supply 13.5 V, ambient 23 °C. Place a force-controlled obstacle at 100 mm. Close the window and apply 81 N once the window reaches the obstacle. Record the time from force reaching 80 N to motor current reaching 0 A. After the stop, record the reversal distance until motion ends. Repeat at 4 mm and 200 mm (pinch zone boundaries). Record stop time and reversal distance in each case.
pass_criteria: Time from pinch force exceeding 80 N to motor stop: within 10 ms; Reversal distance after pinch: at least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less

title: Anti-pinch active in both manual and express close
procedure: Set controller to normalized, supply 13.5 V, ambient 23 °C. Place a force-controlled obstacle at 100 mm. Manual close: hold the switch and close into the obstacle with 81 N applied. Record whether a pinch is detected. Express close: make a 299 ms press in close direction and close into the obstacle with 81 N applied. Record whether a pinch is detected.
pass_criteria: Pinch detected during manual close: [TBD: limit needed]; Pinch detected during express close: [TBD: limit needed]

title: Anti-pinch disabled when controller is not normalized
procedure: Set supply to 13.5 V and window at 240 mm. Interrupt supply for 600 ms to make the controller not normalized. Confirm normalization state in WLC_Status. Place a compliant obstacle at 100 mm fixed to a rig with a 120 N force limit (safety limit for the fixture). Manual close into the obstacle with the switch held. Record whether a pinch is detected and whether the motor continues. Stop the rig, restore normalization by TC-022, and confirm anti-pinch detects the same obstacle as in TC-016.
pass_criteria: Pinch detection while not normalized, obstacle load up to 120 N: [TBD: limit needed]

title: Express close inhibited for 2 s after pinch reversal
procedure: Set controller to normalized, supply 13.5 V, ambient 23 °C, window at 100 mm. Inject a pinch (81 N) during closing to produce a reversal. Define t0 as the end of the reversal movement (the spec does not define the reference; record as a finding). At t0 + 1.9 s (just inside the 2 s window), make a short press in close direction. Record whether express close starts. Repeat at t0 + 2.1 s (just outside the 2 s window) after another pinch reversal. Record whether express close starts.
pass_criteria: Express close inhibited after pinch reversal: 2 s

title: Three pinches within 30 s: manual-only closing for next 60 s
procedure: Set controller to normalized, supply 13.5 V, window at 200 mm. Inject pinch 1 at t = 0 s. Inject pinch 2 at t = 12 s (after the 2 s express inhibit has elapsed). Inject pinch 3 at t = 29 s, which is within 30 s of pinch 1 (just inside the window). From t = 31 s, make a short press in close direction and record whether express close starts. Make a manual hold in close direction and record whether it moves. At t = 88.5 s (just inside the 60 s after pinch 3), attempt express close. At t = 89.5 s (just outside), attempt express close again. Repeat with pinch 3 at t = 30.5 s after pinch 1 (just outside the 30 s window). Record whether the restriction is applied.
pass_criteria: Express close blocked (manual close still allowed) after three pinches within 30 s: 60 s; Express close allowed after restriction ends: 60 s

title: Position resolution 0.5 mm or better from Hall pulses
procedure: Set controller to normalized, supply 13.5 V. Drive the simulated Hall sensor input with pulses corresponding to 0.5 mm steps of window motion. Record the controller-reported position after each step and calculate the smallest reported position change. Repeat with pulses corresponding to 0.25 mm steps and confirm the reported position does not overstate the true position.
pass_criteria: Smallest step in reported window position: 0.5 mm or better

title: Not normalized after supply interruption longer than 500 ms
procedure: Set controller to normalized (see TC-022), supply 13.5 V, ignition on. Interrupt supply for 500 ms (just inside the limit). Read normalization state in WLC_Status. Re-normalize per TC-022. Interrupt supply for 501 ms (just outside the limit). Read normalization state in WLC_Status.
pass_criteria: Normalization state after 501 ms supply interruption: not normalized, after a supply interruption longer than 500 ms; Normalization state after 500 ms supply interruption: [TBD: limit needed]

title: Normalization by holding fully closed against seal for 1 s in manual mode
procedure: Start from not normalized (see TC-021). Set supply 13.5 V, ambient 23 °C. Manual close until the window reaches the seal at fully closed (0 mm). Hold the switch for 0.9 s (just inside), then release. Read normalization state. Move the window open to 240 mm, then manual close to the seal again. Hold the switch for 1.0 s (boundary) and release. Read normalization state. Record the hold time that produces normalization.
pass_criteria: Normalization after holding fully closed against seal in manual mode: 1 s

title: Thermal model implemented to estimate motor temperature
procedure: Obtain the thermal model software design document and parameter set. Review the model structure: inputs (motor current, supply voltage, ambient), states, time constants and output. Confirm the output is used by the thermal protection logic (WLC-025 to WLC-027). Record any missing parameter values or unverified model assumptions as findings.
pass_criteria: Thermal model documented and used for motor temperature estimate: [TBD: limit needed]

title: Motor current limited to 15 A above estimated 130 °C
procedure: Using HIL test access to the controller's estimated motor temperature (access method to be confirmed), set the estimate to 129.9 °C (just inside). Run the motor against a load simulator that demands more than 15 A. Record the steady-state motor current. Set the estimate to 130.1 °C (just outside). Record motor current after it settles. Restore the estimate to ambient after the test.
pass_criteria: Motor current with estimated motor temperature above 130 °C: 15 A

title: Opening blocked above 140 °C, closing allowed
procedure: Set estimated motor temperature to 139.9 °C (just inside). Attempt manual open and record whether the window moves. Set estimate to 140.1 °C (just outside). Attempt manual open and record whether the window moves. At 140.1 °C, attempt manual close and record whether the window moves. Restore estimate to ambient.
pass_criteria: Opening movement at estimated temperature above 140 °C: [TBD: limit needed]; Closing movement at estimated temperature above 140 °C: [TBD: limit needed]

title: Thermal blocking ends when estimate falls below 120 °C
procedure: Set estimate to 140.1 °C so thermal blocking is active. Lower the estimate to 120.1 °C (just above the limit). Attempt manual open and record whether it moves. Lower the estimate to 119.9 °C (just below the limit). Attempt manual open and record whether it moves. Restore estimate to ambient.
pass_criteria: Estimated motor temperature at which opening is again permitted: below 120 °C

title: WLC_Status sent every 50 ms ± 5 ms with required fields
procedure: Set supply 13.5 V, ambient 23 °C. Log CAN bus for 60 s during idle operation. Calculate the period between consecutive WLC_Status messages. Record minimum and maximum period. Repeat during manual and express movement. Verify each message contains window position, movement state, normalization state and fault state.
pass_criteria: WLC_Status period (minimum and maximum over 60 s logs): 50 ms ± 5 ms; Required fields present in WLC_Status: [TBD: limit needed]

title: DTC B1A01 when Hall signal missing for more than 200 ms while motor driven
procedure: Set supply 13.5 V, window at 240 mm, controller normalized. Start manual close so the motor is driven. Remove the Hall signal for 199 ms (just inside the limit) while motor is driven. Restore signal. Read DTCs and clear. Remove the Hall signal for 201 ms (just outside) while motor is driven. Read DTCs. Record time at which motor current reaches 0 A.
pass_criteria: DTC B1A01 stored after Hall signal missing: more than 200 ms; Motor stop after B1A01 is stored: [TBD: limit needed]

title: DTC B1A02 when motor current exceeds 25 A for more than 50 ms
procedure: Set supply 13.5 V, window at 240 mm, motor driven. Inject 25.1 A (just above 25 A) for 49 ms (just inside). Read DTCs. Clear. Inject 25.1 A for 51 ms (just outside). Read DTCs. Inject 24.9 A (just below 25 A) for 1 s. Read DTCs. Clear.
pass_criteria: DTC B1A02 stored when motor current exceeds 25 A: more than 50 ms

title: B1A02 stops motor and sets fault state in WLC_Status
procedure: Set supply 13.5 V, window at 240 mm, motor driven in manual close. Inject 25.1 A for 51 ms to store B1A02. Record time at which motor current reaches 0 A. Read WLC_Status fault state after B1A02 is stored.
pass_criteria: Motor stopped after B1A02 is stored: [TBD: limit needed]; Fault state in WLC_Status after B1A02 is stored: [TBD: limit needed]

title: Response to diagnostic request within 50 ms
procedure: Set supply 13.5 V, ambient 23 °C, controller idle. From the HIL diagnostic tester, send a diagnostic request (request ID [TBD: request ID]). Record time from request end to response start. Repeat 20 times. Repeat 10 times during manual window movement. Record the maximum response time.
pass_criteria: Diagnostic response time (maximum over all requests): within 50 ms

title: Operation over ambient temperature -40 °C to 85 °C
procedure: Place controller in climatic chamber at -40 °C (cold soak). Perform a cold start at 13.5 V, then run one manual open, one manual close, one express close and read WLC_Status. Raise chamber to 85 °C (hot soak) and repeat the same functional checks. Record any function that fails or drifts.
pass_criteria: Functional checks at ambient temperatures: -40 °C to 85 °C

title: Wake from sleep within 100 ms of switch press
procedure: Put the controller in sleep mode (see TC-004 entry conditions), supply 12.0 V, ignition off. Make a switch press. Record time from switch press to wake indication (CAN wake frame or H-bridge enable, whichever is defined). Repeat 10 times in each direction.
pass_criteria: Time from switch press to wake from sleep: within 100 ms
